acts.desc: Ira Glass and Kelefa Sanneh talk about Starbucks’ racial bias training program, which Kalefa recently discussed with Howard Schultz.
acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc: Kelefa Sanneh sits in on one of Starbucks’ anti-racial bias classes. There’s one thing that no one seems to want to talk about.
acts.title: All the Caffeine in the World Doesn’t Make You Woke

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: A group of kids is told that “education is the door to their futures.” But these kids are in jail, facing adult sentences. Why learn algebra when you’re facing 25 years? Eli Hager reports. This story is a collaboration with The Marshall Project, where you can read a print version.
acts.title: Throw the Book at Them

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Daniel Alarcón’s dad was obsessed with soccer when he was growing up, but he was only average at soccer. But those who can’t do...find something else to do. Daniel first told this story on his show Radio Ambulante.
acts.title: Those Who Can’t Play
